description: A ground-level photograph illustrating heathland vegetation at a military training site in Munster, Germany. The foreground and midground are dominated by dense, low-growing shrubs with silvery-green foliage, typical of dwarf shrubs. Further back, patches of darker green, bush-like vegetation are visible, with some brown dry grasses interspersed. In the background, rocky, sparsely vegetated ground rises towards a clear, bright sky. This image serves as an example for Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) land cover classification, referencing data derived from Spot 5 satellite imagery (2.5 metre resolution, 1/2/3 band combination) dated 2011-05-06.
